q: Is an on-site PSA nitrogen generator lower carbon than buying liquid nitrogen?
title: PSA nitrogen vs liquid nitrogen CO2
short: Often yes for steady, moderate purity demand, but it moves emissions into your Scope 2. PSA runs on compressor electricity; liquid nitrogen carries the supplier's air separation power and road transport in your Scope 3. Compare kWh per cubic metre at the purity you need.
audience: Food, pharma, electronics and heat treatment units using nitrogen

ul: PSA: compressor kWh per Nm3 at your purity, from the vendor and a meter.
Liquid: the supplier's kWh per Nm3 if they share it, plus tanker trips.

p: Very high purity needs more air per cubic metre of nitrogen, so PSA power rises. For small or very pure loads, liquid supply may still be the better choice.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills, including kVAh, demand and solar export lines, into dated records with the units, factor and year behind every Scope 2 figure.
